description:
Listed
  Building Consent (part retrospective): Internal and external alterations
  comprising interior strip out of the interior and renewal of decoration.
decision_conditions:
<p>Details from a suitable conservation accredited specialist for the following for 
the listed building shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local 
Planning Authority before any works commence:
</p><p>a) Staircase repairs (including reinstating edge like for like, and locating, 
collecting, repairing and reinstating spindles ie balusters, many/all of which 
that are ‘missing’ remain scattered on site).
</p><p>b) Which doors remain on site, and evidence for where each belongs, and 
how and when they will be reinstated.
</p><p>c) Measured drawings (including profile) for the doors that have been lost 
and need to be reinstated, as well as method statement for reinstatement.</p><p> d) A schedule to show where all fireplace features (surrounds, hearth, marble 
backing) that remain on site have come from within the building, how these
will be reinstated and, where fireplaces and/or their supporting features 
have been lost, how they will be reinstated like for like. </p><p>
e) Sources of water ingress to the building and how these will be repaired 
e.g. that to the staircase, dining room and sitting room.
</p><p>f) Floorboard works (including keeping all remaining historic floorboards 
insitu, how those removed will be reinstated, or where the originals are 
lost, how these will be reinstated to match the originals including 
consideration of evidence of width in holes in the top floor joists, and where 
new flooring is proposed to be laid above this, details of how this will relate 
to skirting).</p><p>REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.</p>

<p>All works of repair and reinstatement hereby approved shall be completed in 
full, in accordance with details required by the conditions attached to this 
consent, within 24 months of the date of this approval.
</p><p>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed 
building.</p>

<p>A full photographic and textual recording report of the entirety of the Listed 
Building shall be undertaken to a Level 4 standard as indicated in the Historic 
England guidance document Understanding Historic Buildings: A Guide to Good 
Recording Practice (Historic England, May 2016) (including the attic and an 
audit of the bricks used in the various phases of construction) and:
</p><p>a) then submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, 
before any works are undertaken.</p><p>
b) following completion of all works hereby approved, and using evidence 
gained during all stages of the implementation of this consent, submitted 
to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. </p><p>
c) The final copy approved under parts (2a) and (2b) is to be submitted to the 
Greater London Historic Environment Record and Harrow Archives, with 
copy of receipt submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning 
Authority, within 2 weeks of the date of their approval.
</p><p> 
REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.</p>

<p>Before the start of works, a site meeting shall be held between the Local 
Planning Authority Conservation Officer and the persons responsible for 
undertaking the works to ensure that the conditions attached to the Listed 
Building Consent are understood and can be complied with in full. Notification 
of the date and time of a meeting shall be made in writing to, and agreed by, the 
Local Planning Authority. The minutes of the meeting shall be submitted to and 
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the start of works.
</p><p> 
REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.</p>

<p>Suitable precautions shall be taken to secure and protect features (including, 
but not limited to, chimney pieces, plasterwork, architraves, timber framing, 
panelling, doors, staircase balustrading) against accidental loss or damage 
during the building work hereby granted, and no such features may be disturbed 
or removed, temporarily or permanently, except as indicated on the approved 
drawings or with the prior approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority.
</p><p> 
REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed 
building</p>

<p>All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to 
the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the 
methods used and materials, colour, texture and profile, unless shown 
otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or 
required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.
</p><p>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed 
building.</p>

<p>During the works, if unknown evidence or hidden historic features are revealed 
this shall be retained in-situ. Works shall be halted in the relevant area of the 
building and the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately. Failure 
to do so may result in unauthorised works being carried out and an offence being 
committed.
</p><p> REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Before work begins, a scheme identifying the items [if any] to be removed; 
arrangements for temporary secure storage; the person or body specialising in 
this procedure appointed by the applicant; the temporary location of the items 
and the name and contact details of the person responsible and a timetable for 
their reinstatement shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local 
Planning Authority. The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in 
accordance with the approved temporary storage scheme.
</p><p> REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Before work begins, the position, type and method of installation of all new and 
relocated services and related fixtures (for the avoidance of doubt this includes 
communications and information technology servicing) including details of all 
electrical, drainage and plumbing and heating services for each floor plan and 
an appraisal how the proposal will impact on any historic fabric (including detail 
of any new notching of beams and perforations to walls, floors and ceilings), 
shall be specified and agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority 
wherever these installations are to be visible, or where ducts or other methods 
of concealment are proposed. The works shall be implemented only in 
accordance with such approval.
</p><p> REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.</p>

<p>Where plasterboard is being replaced with plasterboard, lime plasterboard -
wood-wool boards shall be used.
</p><p> REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the 
listed building.&nbsp;</p>
